title: Elucidating the toxicological impact and mechanism of plasticizers exposure on Alzheimer's disease through network toxicology and molecular docking.
authors: Ge, Yebo; Weng, Yifei; Chen, Ying
journal: Food and chemical toxicology : an international journal published for the British Industrial Biological Research Association
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过网络毒理学和分子对接探讨增塑剂与阿尔茨海默病的关联，虽含分子对接但核心是毒理学靶点筛选，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: This study aimed to explore the underlying mechanisms and key targets of widely used plasticizers, including dimethyl phthalate (DMP), diethyl phthalate (DEP), and dioctyl phthalate (DOP), in the pathogenesis of Alzheimer's disease (AD). Network toxicology, molecular docking, and dynamics simulation screened candidate targets for plasticizer in increasing AD risk. Three machine learning algorithms and two microarray datasets identified key targets, whose immune relevance was assessed by CIBERSORT. An Abeta42-induced BV2 microglia model validated their role. We identified 83 plasticizer targets relevant to AD, which were enriched in KEGG pathways like apoptosis and neuroactive ligand-receptor interaction. CDK5, SLC2A1, and STAT3 were confirmed as key targets, showing consistent differential expression in two AD datasets. Their expression correlated with M1 macrophage infiltration. Molecular docking and dynamics simulations demonstrated that plasticizers stably bind these targets with high affinity. In Abeta42-induced BV2 microglia, phthalate treatment elevated inflammatory factors (TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6) and STAT3 expression. This study demonstrated the possible mechanistic associations between plasticizers exposure and AD, and STAT3 might be the key target of plasticizers.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨广泛使用的增塑剂，包括邻苯二甲酸二甲酯（DMP）、邻苯二甲酸二乙酯（DEP）和邻苯二甲酸二辛酯（DOP），在阿尔茨海默病（AD）发病机制中的潜在机制和关键靶点。通过网络毒理学、分子对接和动力学模拟筛选增塑剂增加AD风险的候选靶点。三种机器学习算法和两个微阵列数据集识别出关键靶点，并通过CIBERSORT评估其免疫相关性。通过Abeta42诱导的BV2小胶质细胞模型验证了其作用。我们识别出83个与AD相关的增塑剂靶点，这些靶点富集在KEGG通路中，如凋亡和神经活性配体-受体相互作用。CDK5、SLC2A1和STAT3被确认为关键靶点，在两个AD数据集中显示出一致的差异表达。它们的表达与M1巨噬细胞浸润相关。分子对接和动力学模拟表明，增塑剂能稳定地以高亲和力结合这些靶点。在Abeta42诱导的BV2小胶质细胞中，邻苯二甲酸酯处理升高了炎症因子（TNF-alpha、IL-1beta、IL-6）和STAT3的表达。本研究证明了增塑剂暴露与AD之间可能的机制关联，STAT3可能是增塑剂的关键靶点。
